name: Paid Content
description: Not a published list: built so the sweeps reach Vantage Point's first NBN cards — Nihilo Agent, Grubber, Paywall, Scapegoat — on Hyper Velocity's frame, under Making News. Eternal-legal only. Vantage Point Stage 3a: Hype Machine for AMAZE Amusements, Magistrate Revontulet for Nihilo Agent. Vantage Point Stage 4a: two Lethe for two Tithe. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 1: two Capacitor and two Seraph for three Ping and the Whitespace, which the deck's tags feed, and two The Powers That Be for two Hedge Fund. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 4a: two Kingmaking for two Orbital Superiority, for the Superconducting Hub to follow into the score area. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 4c: two Stoke the Embers for the last Orbital Superiority and the Offworld Office, for The Powers That Be to install out of Archives; The Holo Man for the Hansei Review and Janaína “JK” Dumont Kindelán for the Hedge Fund. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 5a: two Piranhas for a Funhouse and a Paywall, rezzed off the deck's tags, and two Sudden Commandment for two Predictive Planogram. The Automata Initiative Stage 1: two Balanced Coverage for two Public Trail, and two Behold! for the Spin Doctor and the Predictive Planogram. The Automata Initiative Stage 2: two Your Digital Life for two Scapegoat, two B-1001 for Public Trail and Tithe. The Automata Initiative Stage 3: two Virtual Service Agent for two Paywall, ice for ice. The Automata Initiative Stage 8d: two Oracle Thinktank for the Tomorrow's Headline and a Neurospike, point for point, for the Corp to take back off the tag it gives. Parhelion Stage 1: two Gaslight, two Nonequivalent Exchange, two Post-Truth Dividend and a third Kingmaking for its Neurospike, two Manegarm Skunkworks, two Funhouse, a Send a Message and its Superconducting Hub, point for point. Parhelion Stage 3a: two Freedom of Information for its two Stoke the Embers, a requirement the tags it gives lower. Parhelion Stage 8: two Klevetnik for two Seraph, and two Unsmiling Tsarevna for two Piranhas, rezzed on a run at their server. Midnight Sun Stage 4: two Drago Ivanov, two Vladisibirsk City Grid and two Chekist Scion for its two Behold, two Gaslight and two Balanced Coverage — advanceable cards to share a root with the grid, and Drago keeps the deck Eternal-only. Uprising Stage 1: two Bellona for two Send a Message, point for point; every Corp deck keeps Send a Message. Uprising Stage 4: two Digital Rights Management for its two Sudden Commandment, an operation for an operation; Spin Cycle and Grand Opening keep Sudden Commandment. Downfall Stage 3: two Increased Drop Rates for two Hype Machine, an ambush that sheds a bad publicity unless the Runner takes a tag. Downfall Stage 4: two Daily Quest for two B-1001, three credits a turn the Runner pays two to stop, and two Focus Group for two Nonequivalent Exchange, advancement counters bought off a revealed grip.
